ov: A small, pale sandy cat of sandy and stony deserts far from water. Its low-set ears help it hear prey moving underground, and thick fur on the soles of its paws protects them from hot sand. It hunts at night.
rg: Scattered through the deserts of North Africa, the Arabian Peninsula, the Middle East and Central Asia.
df: Small rodents, birds and lizards; it also kills venomous snakes.
fx: Its hearing is about 8 decibels more sensitive than a domestic cat’s.
It rests in underground dens during the day.
notes: RESOLVED 2026-09-29 (owner: approve all; animals.js updated): ANSWER CHECK (fact): "can go weeks without drinking, taking water from its prey" is half sourced: it gets its moisture from prey, but "weeks" isn’t in the article.
